A NOTE ABOUT THE JOURNEY

Follow curiosity.
Keep your bearings.

Rabbit Hole is a visual reading playground. Start with a question, follow a connection and collect the path you take.

Connections are invitations

The starter map uses original editorial notes and hand-picked thematic connections. A line between two ideas is a prompt to explore, not proof of a causal relationship. This version does not generate AI answers or fact-check sources.

Go beyond the starter map

Search and “Explore article links” use Wikipedia’s public API. Live notes are introductory extracts, and live connections are links found in the article. They may be broad or incidental. Always open the source for context and references.

Your trails belong to you

Your graph, notes and saved trails stay in this browser’s local storage. Export a workspace for a portable backup. No account or analytics code is built into the app. Interface fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. Searching sends your query to Wikipedia; loading live topics sends their titles. Hosting and source providers may process ordinary request data. Shared links contain topic titles from your trail. Avoid private or sensitive topics in links you share.

Wikipedia extracts: © Wikipedia contributors, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Each live note links to its article and history. Editorial notes are starting points, not exhaustive accounts.
